item.title: DNA and vehicle-tracking help French investigators recover stolen Renoirs
item.description: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.
item.content:encoded:
DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.

(Image credit: Philippe Magoni)

item.title: RJ Mitte, 'Breaking Bad' actor and disability rights champion, dies at 34
item.description: Actor and disability rights advocate RJ Mitte, who brought a lifetime of experience with cerebral palsy to fictional family struggles in an essential role on "Breaking Bad," died Monday at age 34.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
item.description: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.

item.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
item.description: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

item.title: Actor Selma Blair removed from plane by police after altercation
item.description: Authorities say Blair was physically abusive and injured two flight attendants while traveling from Los Angeles to New York. A Blair representative said she had a medical emergency aboard the plane.

item.title: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
item.description: Opposition parties say revisions to the list of eligible voters favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.

item.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
item.description: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

item.title: Fontaines D.C.'s decadent, dystopian vision of our time
item.description: "I just want to make people really feel things about the world they live in," Grian Chatten says of Dopamine Chamber, which he describes as the band's attempt to map the tensions of our moment.

item.title: Mahershala Ali is still hungry as an actor: 'Let's fail on camera until we find it'
item.description: Ali plays a devout Muslim family man, who also happens to be an assassin in Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother. After decades in the business and two Oscars, he says he has less fear as an actor.
